calls.topic: Should I rent or buy a flat in Berlin?
calls.label: Laying out the board
calls.final:
I've set this up as a choice between renting, buying now, and waiting to buy, with suggested wants on cost, flexibility, risk and time. Keep or skip the wants, add your own, then press Fill.

```map
{"ops":[
{"op":"add","id":"rent-or-buy","parent":null,"kind":"question","title":"Rent or buy in Berlin?","summary":"Decide whether to keep renting or buy a flat in Berlin.","status":"open"},
{"op":"add","id":"keep-renting","parent":"rent-or-buy","kind":"option","title":"Keep things as they are","summary":"Stay renting your current flat; invest the savings instead.","status":"proposed"},
{"op":"add","id":"buy-now","parent":"rent-or-buy","kind":"option","title":"Buy a flat now","summary":"Buy an owner-occupied flat now with a mortgage.","status":"proposed"},
{"op":"add","id":"wait-buy","parent":"rent-or-buy","kind":"option","title":"Wait, buy in 1–2 years","summary":"Keep renting, build your deposit, and watch rates and prices.","status":"proposed"},
{"op":"frame","q":"rent-or-buy","shape":"choose","keepAsIs":"keep-renting"},
{"op":"want","q":"rent-or-buy","id":"w-monthly-cost","title":"Affordable monthly housing cost","weight":"must"},
{"op":"want","q":"rent-or-buy","id":"w-wealth","title":"Builds long-term wealth","weight":"matters"},
{"op":"want","q":"rent-or-buy","id":"w-flex","title":"Easy to move or undo","weight":"matters"},
{"op":"want","q":"rent-or-buy","id":"w-security","title":"Secure against eviction, rent hikes","weight":"matters"},
{"op":"want","q":"rent-or-buy","id":"w-risk","title":"Limited price and rate risk","weight":"must"},
{"op":"want","q":"rent-or-buy","id":"w-effort","title":"Low hassle and upkeep","weight":"nice"},
{"op":"stand","q":"rent-or-buy","lead":null,"line":"Your deposit, how long you'll stay, and the price-to-rent ratio would decide it.","sure":null}
]}
```

calls.topic: Should I rent or buy a flat in Berlin?
calls.label: Filling the board
calls.final:

calls.topic: Why did my sourdough loaf not rise?
calls.label: Going deeper
calls.final:
I've broken the weak-starter cause into what makes a starter sluggish and two quick checks you can run at home. The doubling test is still the cheapest way to rule it in or out.

```map
{"ops":[
{"op":"add","id":"f-starter-age","parent":"c-weak-starter","kind":"fact","title":"Young starters are often weak","summary":"Starters under ~2 weeks old often bubble but can't raise dough yet.","status":"info"},
{"op":"add","id":"f-starter-temp","parent":"c-weak-starter","kind":"fact","title":"Cold slows starter activity","summary":"Below ~20°C, starter activity slows a lot; peak may take 12h+.","status":"info"},
{"op":"add","id":"f-starter-timing","parent":"c-weak-starter","kind":"fact","title":"Used before or after peak","summary":"Starter used too early or long after peak gives less lift.","status":"info"},
{"op":"add","id":"k-float-test","parent":"c-weak-starter","kind":"fact","title":"Float and smell check","summary":"To check: does a spoonful float, smelling yeasty not acetone? Shows readiness.","status":"info"},
{"op":"add","id":"k-starter-history","parent":"c-weak-starter","kind":"fact","title":"Starter age and routine","summary":"To check: how old is it, how often fed, kitchen temperature?","status":"info"},
{"op":"move","id":"k-starter-test","parent":"c-weak-starter"},
{"op":"update","id":"c-weak-starter","summary":"Starter too young, cold, or used off-peak to make enough gas."},
{"op":"takeaway","node":"k-starter-test","text":"Run first: doubling in 4–8h rules a weak starter out."},
{"op":"stand","q":"q-root","lead":null,"line":"No cause leads yet; the starter doubling test and dough's look before baking would separate them.","sure":null}
]}
```
